# SMAA

The `External/smaa` Git submodule is pinned to `71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d` from [iryoku/smaa](https://github.com/iryoku/smaa).

Herta includes the unmodified reference `SMAA.hlsl` through a Slang adapter and uploads the reference `Textures/AreaTex.h` and `Textures/SearchTex.h` lookup data. The upstream MIT license remains in the submodule. Update the pin, recook shaders, and rerun native renderer readback tests together.
